description: Shortlists advisers of The Bitcoin Adviser whose recorded details confirm what was asked. Deterministic, matching rules version 1. audience is holder (a Bitcoin holder or family), professional (an attorney, CPA, notary or family office advising clients) or media (a host or organiser). need (not for media): smsf, ira, custody, education, inheritance, corporate, family_office; smsf is an Australian SMSF and ira a US IRA. language: en, es, fr, it, de, nl, ja. market (optional, never required): americas, au-nz, europe, japan, africa. Returns outcome "shortlist" (up to 3, or every match with all=true, each with fixed-wording reasons), "insufficient" (no audience, or neither need nor language) or "no-match"; every result carries the team contact route. Matching uses confirmed facts only; a shortlist is not a recommendation or a judgement of competence, and equal matches are ordered by name. It does not book a call or contact anyone. The need "custody" means help securing bitcoin the person holds themselves, through collaborative security. It does not mean The Bitcoin Adviser holds anyone's bitcoin.
name: find_adviser
title: Find an adviser
